body:
With NX8's 8-bit static formats, the tensor that loses most even in its best format is layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256: 32.1 dB SQNR (signal-to-quantization-noise ratio; higher is better) in fp8_e2m5, measured on that tensor alone by the format search. Measured on 41 models with a format search (of 290 surveyed).

Model outputs keep a median 23.1 dB SQNR against full precision, the worst 2.8 dB (Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct). 23 of 31 models with a prediction metric (top-1, perplexity or agreement) lose some of it; the most: microsoft/table-transformer-structure-recognition (agreement 100% → 0%: the share of samples whose predicted class matches full precision's), PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (agreement 100% → 0%: the share of samples whose predicted class matches full precision's) and Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (perplexity 16.5 → 94.5, higher is worse).

The tensors that lose most in their best format (their own error): layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 32.1 dB), linear bias in Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (fp8_e3m4, 33.0 dB), layernorm bias in Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B (fp8_e2m5, 33.3 dB), linear bias in mattmdjaga/segformer_b2_clothes (fp8_e2m5, 33.5 dB), linear bias in SamLowe/roberta-base-go_emotions (fp8_e2m5, 33.6 dB), linear bias in deepset/roberta-base-squad2 (fp8_e2m5, 33.6 dB), linear output in Arunavaonly/Bangla-twoclass-Sentiment-Analyzer (fp8_e3m4, 33.8 dB), linear bias in facebook/bart-large-cnn (fp8_e2m5, 33.9 dB), add output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.0 dB) and embedding output in BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (fp8_e2m5, 34.1 dB).

Separately, the error accumulated along the data path (every tensor before a node quantized too): reciprocal outputs end furthest from full precision, PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 keeping only -inf dB there. The outputs furthest from full precision in each model's best format set: reciprocal in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), mul in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), div in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), log in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), reciprocal in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), mul in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), div in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), log in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), div in microsoft/table-transformer-structure-recognition (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB) and amin in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -758.2 dB, with full precision's selection forced).

Formats chosen (E = exponent bits, M = mantissa bits, u = unsigned): fp8_e2m5 19595 (59%), fp8_e3m4 9431 (28%), fp8_e1m6 4080 (12%), fp8_e4m3 2 (under 0.01%); 0% of tensors use an unsigned format.

A wider format or a per-row choice would recover most where a tensor's own error in its format, times its data, is largest: softmax output in openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo (fp8_e2m5, 37.4 dB), softmax output in openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo (fp8_e2m5, 37.7 dB) and softmax output in openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo (fp8_e2m5, 38.7 dB).
